notes.title: Volantia - Patch 1.41
notes.notes:
18/02/2018

Added new hotkeys:
[list]
    [*]F - fullscreen / windowed
    [*]WASD - move camera
    [*]Z - open island menu
    [*]X - open production menu
    [*]C - open housing menu
    [*]V - open service menu
    [*]B - open science menu
    [*]N - build road tool
    [*]T - open tech tree
[/list]

Added new text:
[list]
    [*]tutorial now talks about camera controls
    [*]tutorial now talks about rotating islands
    [*]extra help screen with basic controls
[/list]

Gameplay changes:
[list]
    [*]Zardim now act like they do in sandbox mode, once the kingdom is stabilised
[/list]

notes.title: Build a kingdom in the sky in puzzle/sim blend Volantia
notes.notes:
One of the great things about games is that you really can just take two disparate concepts, mash them together and come away with something genuinely good. Volantia: Kingdom In The Sky from Tangled Mess Games (featuring some of the talent behind the lovely micro-roguelike Desktop Dungeons) is a blend of city-building management and block-tessellation puzzle, and it launched today.
